metadata.subject: English Grammar

learning_outcomes: Identify nouns and verbs in a sentence

ai_context.tutor_hint: Have students identify parts of speech in their own names.

content.text: A Noun is a naming word. It names a person, place, thing, or idea. (Example: 'Dog', 'London', 'Happiness').

content.question: Which of the following is a Noun?
content.explanation: An Elephant is an animal (a thing), making it a noun!
